lia: quick dump from tonight's perf run on AWQ weight-only int8. comparing group=64 vs group=128. short seq (32, b=1): g64 = ~400 tok/s, g128 = ~520 tok/s. long seq (1024, b=4): g64 = ~9.8k tok/s, g128 = ~10.2k tok/s. packing overhead seems to dominate for short sequences.
sam: can you attach the flamegraph / nvtx timeline? want to see memcpy vs compute gaps.
lia: pasted trimmed nvtx stack (attaching snippet):
```
[NVTX] timeline:
- pack_weights_cpu: 22%
- quant_dequant: 12%
- gemm_int8_kernel: 45%
- cudaMemcpyAsync host->dev: 18%
- kernel_launch_overhead: 3%
```
Looks like CPU-side pack + memcpy are killing short-seq latency.
miguel: that matches what i saw in the pack profiler: we serialize group blocks into a temporary buffer then memcpy. serialization is single-threaded for small models which amplifies overhead. also observed lock contention on weight cache when multiple requests try to initialize packed state.
ops-bot: perf-runner: job 2026-03-17-42 completed (sha: d3f4b1). artifacts uploaded to s3://redwood-perf/awq/1852345678/
mina: two quick hypotheses: (1) kernel selector is falling back to an fp16/packed-less path for short seqs because kernel heuristics expect larger work per launch, (2) calibration step (we're running per-layer calibration for AWQ) adds extra copying/align-and-scan that slows startup.
sam: both are plausible. we should try: - prepacking weights on load (keep packed weights resident on GPU) - change allocator to pinned host memory for pack buffer - tweak kernel selector to prefer int8_gemm for small batches when packed blocks are ready.
lia: small profiling note: enabling prepack_in_gpu (experimental) moved memcpy down to 6% but increased GPU memory usage by ~300MB. end-to-end short-seq g64 improved from 400 -> 590 tok/s (now slightly better than g128), so packing locality helps a lot.
miguel: nice. can you run a micro-benchmark that toggles: pack_on_load=true, pinned_buffer=true, pack_threads=4? something like:
```bash
./perf_client --model llama-awq --group-size 64 --seq-len 32 --batch 1 --prefetch-pack --pack-threads 4 --use-pinned-buffer
```
collect nvtx and the `pack_latency_ms` metric.
lia: will run tomorrow morning on the p4d cluster and post traces. i'll also flip off calibration to measure its delta. preliminary: calibration enabled vs disabled added ~12% token time for short seqs due to repeated stats passes and extra buffer syncs.
mina: add a canary test: short-seq awq g64 baseline -> alert if throughput drops >8% vs baseline after deploy. also add a regression guard for memory overhead when prepack enabled.
sam: one more ask: add a tiny kernel-bench that simulates the packed-block sizes produced by our group-size optimizer and run across cuda/cuBLAS/oneDNN int8 kernels so we can build a kernel-choice table. iirc we have gaps where our selector picks a slower kernel for certain block shapes.
lia: agreed. adding to backlog and creating a PR draft for the kernel chooser change. i'll include perf numbers, nvtx traces, and the micro-bench scripts. tagging @sam @miguel for review. :thumbsup:
mina: :+1: please also log which models (llama-2-13b, mpt-7b) since pack density differs by architecture.
lia: noted — i'll include both. attaching artifact link once done: s3://redwood-perf/awq/1852345678/ (contains traces, perf.log, microbench configs).
